30    /**
31     * Register of the National Economy
32     *
33     * @see http://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/REGON
34     *
35     * @return string 9 digit number
36     */
37    public static function regon()
38    {
39        $weights = [8, 9, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7];
40        $regionNumber = self::numberBetween(0, 49) * 2 + 1;
41        $result = [(int) ($regionNumber / 10), $regionNumber % 10];
42
43        for ($i = 2, $size = count($weights); $i < $size; ++$i) {
44            $result[$i] = static::randomDigit();
45        }
46        $checksum = 0;
47
48        for ($i = 0, $size = count($result); $i < $size; ++$i) {
49            $checksum += $weights[$i] * $result[$i];
50        }
51        $checksum %= 11;
52
53        if ($checksum == 10) {
54            $checksum = 0;
55        }
56        $result[] = $checksum;
57
58        return implode('', $result);
59    }
